description: This file contains the implementation of the Transaction class within the Opencart system, specifically for handling email notifications related to transactions in the catalog controller mail namespace.

classes.name: Transaction
classes.description: Handles the sending of transaction notification emails to customers within the OpenCart catalog mail controller namespace.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Prepares and sends an email notification about a transaction, including customer info, store info, and transaction details, with support for multiple languages and email configurations.
